_comment: useEntityPage — the search, filter, tag and pagination state behind every list page (Users, Groups, Identities). A wrong filter here silently shows a different population, and nothing on screen says the list is not what was asked for. Split out of stryker.hooks.config.json rather than added to it: measured together the two scopes took 58 minutes against a 60-minute CI budget, because every mutant pays for every test in the include set, and useEntityPage's ~320 mutants were each loading MatrixView.mount and App.mount for nothing. Splitting on which mount test each hook actually needs cuts per-mutant cost instead of dividing the same work. Run: cd app/ui && npm run test:mutation:listhooks. TEST INCLUDE is useEntityPage.test.jsx plus EntityListPage.mount.test.jsx, and parity was checked rather than assumed -- coverage under those two matches the full UI suite exactly (79.69/71.71/84.31/80.24, same uncovered lines). It was 4 branches short until the sidecar-failure tests were written: the failure arms of the columns and tags fetches had only ever been reached incidentally by a mount test elsewhere in the suite, which is both the wrong home for that contract and precisely the dependency that becomes a false survivor when a scope narrows. MUTATOR SET: StringLiteral and ObjectLiteral excluded, matching every other config here -- string mutation was 20-43% of the mutants in each scope measured and is re-paid every week for an uneven return. MEASURED 57.50% over 402 mutants in 14 minutes; FLOOR 55, ratcheting up only. 64 of its mutants are unreached, so there is a lot left here -- the file is 162 lines of search, filter, tag and pagination state and the least covered of the UI hooks at 80.2% line. RUNTIME CAVEAT WORTH KEEPING: an overnight run of this same config reported 585 minutes. That was the machine sleeping, not the work -- one full pass of its two test files takes 5.5 seconds, and re-running it awake gave 14 minutes. If a mutation run ever reports hours, check whether the host stayed awake before believing it or tuning anything.
tests_comment: Standalone rather than spreading vite.config.js, for the same reason as the other
vitest.stryker.* configs: Stryker sandboxes app/ui alone, so the normal test include
reaching ../../tools/crawlers/** resolves nothing there and aborts the run.
TWO TEST FILES, AND THAT IS THE POINT OF THIS CONFIG EXISTING. useEntityPage was
originally measured alongside the matrix hooks, which meant every one of its ~320
mutants also paid for MatrixView.mount and App.mount to load. Splitting on which
mount test each hook actually needs cuts per-mutant cost rather than merely dividing
the same work between two jobs.
Parity checked, not assumed: coverage of useEntityPage under these two files is
79.69% stmts / 71.71% branch / 84.31% funcs / 80.24% lines, identical to the full UI
suite with the same uncovered lines. It was 4 branches short until the sidecar-failure
tests were added to useEntityPage.test.jsx — those arms had only ever been reached
incidentally by a mount test elsewhere in the suite, which is both a poor place for
the contract to live and exactly the kind of dependency that turns into a false
survivor when a scope is narrowed.

src/utils/matchedOn.test.js: src/utils/matchedOn.js (the "Matched on" text and the 3-character rule) joined this scope: its own test, plus the two above that drive it through useEntityPage and EntityListPage.

mutationExclusions.src/components/ExtendedSearchToggle.jsx: The "All attributes" checkbox: one label, one input, one tooltip, no decision of its own. Whether the extended search is actually sent — the 3-character rule and the remembered setting — is useEntityPage.js and src/utils/matchedOn.js, both mutated above; the checkbox driving it end to end is asserted in EntityListPage.mount.test.jsx and ContextSearchResults.mount.test.jsx.
mutationExclusions.src/components/IncludeDeletedToggle.jsx: The "Include deleted" checkbox: one label, one input, one tooltip, no decision of its own. What it changes — the includeDeleted query parameter — is useEntityPage.js (mutated above) and the AccessPackagesPage fetch; the checkbox driving the list end to end is asserted in EntityListPage.mount.test.jsx and AccessPackagesPage.mount.test.jsx.
mutationExclusions.src/components/contexts/ContextSearchRes: The Contexts pane's result list: four render states (searching, error, no match, list) over useContextSearch. The URL it fetches — including when it asks for an extended search — is contextSearchUrl in src/hooks/useContextTrees.js, the label text is src/utils/matchedOn.js (mutated above), and the matching itself is the API's lib/entitySearch.js (mutated in app/api/stryker.matrix.config.json). Each of the four states, the open-on-click and the 'tick All attributes' hint (shown only when it is off) is asserted in ContextSearchResults.mount.test.jsx.
